messages.content: Here is a long block of text: a slow drift of mornings stacked on top of one another like folded sheets in a drawer that has been opened so many times the hinges no longer creak the way they used to and the light from the window arrives the same way each morning except for a small variation in how it moves across the floor that nobody notices because the cat has moved and the cat moves whenever it wants and the kettle boils with that same particular whistle and everybody pretends not to hear it for a few seconds longer than necessary a slow drift of mornings stacked on top of one another like folded sheets in a drawer that has been opened so many times the hinges no longer creak the way they used to and the light from the window arrives the same way each morning except for a small variation in how it moves across the floor that nobody notices because the cat has moved and the cat moves whenever it wants and the kettle boils with that same particular whistle and everybody pretends not to hear it for a few seconds longer than necessary a slow drift of mornings stacked on top of one another like folded sheets in a drawer that has been opened so many times the hinges no longer creak the way they used to and the light from the window arrives the same way each morning except for a small variation in how it moves across the floor that nobody notices because the cat has moved and the cat moves whenever it wants and the kettle boils with that same particular whistle and everybody pretends not to hear it for a few seconds longer than necessary .
